description: This file provides utility functions for normalizing chat messages, including handling message content, roles, and identifying tool result messages.

methods.name: normalizeMessage
methods.description: Converts a raw message object into a standardized normalized message structure, handling roles, content, and metadata.

methods.name: normalizeRoleForGrouping
methods.description: Normalizes a role string for grouping purposes, preserving core roles and distinguishing tool roles.

methods.name: isToolResultMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message is a tool result based on its role.
